categories.title: Passive components
categories.blurb: Parts that store, resist or filter energy without amplifying it: the resistors, capacitors, inductors and the protection that keeps the rest alive.

categories.title: Discrete semiconductors
categories.blurb: One junction, one job: diodes that pass one way, transistors that switch or amplify, thyristors that latch, and the parts that turn light into current and back.

categories.title: Integrated circuits
categories.blurb: Whole circuits on a chip: analog blocks, logic, memory, processing and the interface chips that connect a board to the world.

categories.title: Electromechanical
categories.blurb: The parts that move, click and connect: switches, relays, connectors, motors, speakers and the hardware a circuit is mounted on.

categories.title: Power sources and conversion
categories.blurb: Where the current comes from and how it is changed: cells, batteries, supplies, inverters and the boards that distribute what they make.

categories.title: Radio frequency and wireless
categories.blurb: The parts that work in wavelengths: antennas, filters, mixers, amplifiers and the modules that put a signal in the air.

categories.title: Sensors and transducers
categories.blurb: Devices that turn a physical quantity into a signal: heat, motion, pressure, light, gas, current and touch.

categories.title: Boards, packaging and wiring
categories.blurb: What holds a circuit together: the board itself, the packages, the solder, the cable and the box it lives in.

categories.title: Test and measurement
categories.blurb: The bench: what measures a signal, what generates one, and what joins the two without melting the board.
